text:
Marcos: FYI — got a ping from VoltEdge (appliance HW partner). They want joint SI co-sell rules for pipeline claims when a lead mentions their appliance in a marketplace listing.
Priya: important — we need a tight rule so SIs don't double-claim with marketplace reps.
Tom: can we do a precedence rule? e.g., if lead source == marketplace then marketplace SDR owns first 7 days, else SI intake owns? :thinking_face:
Aisha: +1 to precedence, but also need account mapping when the customer already has an SI relationship. overlapping accounts are the pain.
Marcos: proposal draft below — please react with :thumbsup: if ok or comment. High level:
Marcos: 1) Source precedence: Marketplace-intake > Existing SI relationship tag > Direct partner referral > Organic
Marcos: 2) If SI tag exists in Salesforce, SI gets the lead ownership but marketplace rep gets co-owner tag and 3 business day SLA to respond.
Priya: SLA seems fair. add: if SI declines within 48h, ownership flips to marketplace SDR automatically.
Tom: workflow needs a simple claim button in our intake app. example command: `/claim-lead 78321 --owner=SI --partner=VoltEdge`
Aisha: also need an account-matching heuristic: match on domain + company_size_bucket + 2 of (region, ARR, vertical). if fuzzy match > 0.8 then auto-attach SI tag.
Marcos: sample mapping YAML for intake rules (for eng/ops):
Marcos: ```
source_priority:
  - marketplace
  - si_tag
  - partner_referral
  - organic
si_response_window_days: 2
marketplace_response_window_days: 3
auto_flip_if_decline_hours: 48
account_match_threshold: 0.8
``` 
Priya: can we add a gating flag for HW-appliance deals > $250k to require AM + Partner Solutions engineer intro? those often need joint tech validation and HW procurement.
Tom: yes, add threshold rule and an automatic invite template for joint kickoff: `invite: AM, SI_PM, VoltEdge_SE, Redwood_Sales`.
Aisha: ops question — who enforces the flip? should be a CRON job that marks ownership and posts in #partnerships with a short note.
announce-bot: automated: New intake rule created: appliance_co_sell_v1. Owner flip scheduled if SI declines within 48h. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/appliance_co_sell_v1
Marcos: next steps: Priya to finalize SLA text, Tom to add claim button to intake app, Aisha to add matching heuristic to account linker, ops to schedule enforcement job. Ping me when PRs created.
Priya: will draft SLA this afternoon and post in this thread for quick review.
Tom: I'll put a small prototype PR by EOD and add acceptance tests for the command.
Aisha: starting the matcher ticket now, will add test vectors for VoltEdge-style names (appliance, ai-appliance, edge-box).
Marcos: thanks team — goal is to pilot with VoltEdge marketplace listings next week. if the pilot looks good, we’ll roll to other HW partners. :rocket:
